newsitem.title: USA: Shell, Texaco talks on track despite suit.
newsitem.headline: Shell, Texaco talks on track despite suit.

text.p: A Shell Oil Co spokeswoman on Monday said allegations leveled against Texaco Inc executives in a racial discrimination lawsuit have not derailed talks to merge the companies' U.S. refining and marketing operations.

"We have discussed the issue with Texaco, and are convinced that the alleged misconduct is in strict violation of Texaco's policies, values and standards, and that Texaco is committed to deal with the issue aggresively," she said. "Our negotiations with Texaco continue."
Shell President Philip Carroll said the companies could reach agreement on the alliance "in a matter of weeks."
Texaco according to news reports is in talks aimed at settling a 1994 racial discrimination lawsuit.
